{{Quote|Ko Bas asked me to boil bean juice for him today. Is that all I am? A bean juice boiler? I showed him though&mdash;a little spittle in the bean juice may be just what Ko Bas needs.|Celis Bol's personal log|<ref name="Caaried Away">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away}}</ref>}}
'''Bean juice''' was a type of juice. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Ko Bas]], the [[Overseer of Cartel Operations, Tilnes Special Detachment|overseer]] of a [[Metatheran Cartel]] base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], asked the [[Caarite]] [[Celis Bol]] to boil some bean juice for him. Bol considered the task to be menial, so she spat in Bas' juice.
